narration: A bet can have a positive expected return and still lose you money over time. Imagine a coin toss. Heads gains fifty percent. Tails loses forty percent. The expected multiplier is one point zero five. But one win followed by one loss turns a dollar into just ninety cents. Average outcomes across people aren't the same as the path you actually live. Follow Avoid Boring People for more ideas about risk and decisions.
